layout: 2x2 equal grid: rifle, heavy, specialist, commander

prompts.stonewall: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production card-art atlas for an offline tactical science-fiction game. Create ONE square contact sheet in a strict 2 by 2 grid, four equal square illustrations edge to edge with no gutters, no borders and no divider lines. Each quadrant is a separate waist-up character portrait with its own dark atmospheric background. IMPORTANT positions: top left rifle infantry; top right heavy weapons soldier; bottom left specialist; bottom right commander. Every character centered in its own quadrant with head fully visible, torso and weapon occupying the frame, distinct poses, very readable at small size. Style: polished graphic-novel military concept art, angular shapes, confident ink contours, selective painterly shading, strong silhouettes, dramatic rim lighting, stylized rather than photorealistic. Restrained near-future science-fiction, no fantasy armor. No text, names, labels, numbers, insignia lettering, card frames, watermarks or UI. Do not put objects across quadrant boundaries. STONEWALL faction: disciplined fortified defenders, slate steel and pale cyan accents. Rifle infantry in angular reinforced helmet and plate carrier with compact carbine. Heavy in broad reinforced plating holding an enormous shield and support gun. Specialist field engineer/medic with cyan diagnostic wrist instrument, utility armor and compact pack. Commander in angular armored officer uniform, unhelmeted stern mature face, tactical hologram, broad bunker-like shoulder armor. Dark bunker and ruined military checkpoint backgrounds. Cool cyan edge light.
